game_start.intro: Mupila ulayamba. Suit ya trump: {trump_suit} (kadi ya trump: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Niwe Player {player_id} mu German Whist.
{phase_info}
Ukuboko kwenu kwa {hand_size} kadi.
Lambula kadi na '[play N]', apo N ni nafasi ya kadi mu mukuboko wenu (nga nshi '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: IFYO BALISHIBA: Uulecimfya mu busekese bonse alapokelela kardi ya pa muulu e lyo uufilwa akabuula na yambi. Amacinda ayacitwa muli ubu busekesi tayabalwa nga ca kuti umuntu alicimfishe ubusanso bwa kubalilapo.
player_prompt.phase_playing: IFIKO FYA KUSENELA: kalulu ya kuseba umutwele. Ili nganda yonse kuti pano ikalenga kushinda.

next_card.playing_phase: Takwaba icikope ca kwishibilako - inshita ya kulalwa yatendeka.
next_card.deck_empty: Icitabo tacakwete nangu kamo - tapali na maka ya kupeela.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomu ya kupiga si sahihi. Tumia '[play N]' kupiga kadi ya Nth mu mukuboko wenu.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Mufwile ukulakonka ifyo bacita no kulabomfya kalata ya {lead_suit}.

trick.won: Umulashi {winner_id} alicimfya icipuupu nga ca kuti ali na {card}.
trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} alishinda trick na {card} na akatola kadi iliyo juu.

phase.learning_complete: Icipampa calikapwa. Isambililo lyalipwa - ubucenjeshi bonse bwasala bwalicindama ku kucimfya.

draw.loser_received: Mwalilufishe ubucenjeshi no kusenda {card} ukufuma mu cipao.
draw.winner_preview: Icitabo cikonkelepo pali iyi kalata ni {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Mikunjo iliyoshikiliwa mpaka sasa - Mchezaji 0: {tricks0}, Mchezaji 1: {tricks1}

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Takwaba ifya kucita mu kuboko kwesu.
